name: instead_of_on_table
comment: INSTEAD OF on a table exists only on SQL Server; SQLite and PostgreSQL refuse with DDL-005 (they have it on views only).

trigger.name: trg_widgets_instead
trigger.sql: update widgets set deleted = 1 where id in (select o.id from {old: id} o);

drop: if object_id(N'trg_widgets_instead', N'TR') is not null drop trigger [trg_widgets_instead]
